offerings.cycle_label: Summer 2026 junior volunteer programme - applications closed
offerings.summary: Teens who are fourteen and have finished eighth grade by 15 June 2026 complete mandatory training in mid June and then serve eight three-hour shifts across the eight weeks from 22 June to 14 August 2026.
